scope: Complete real official EPA archive: all 90 native state codes publish; all 56 registered U.S. jurisdictions pass normal API, card, and Ask evidence-adapter reads at three scheduler clocks.

nationalIngest.mode: One actual production OpenDataSpool holds every real national row before materialization; source HTTP bytes are held from the actual official capture.

historicalTimingFields: nationalIngest is the exact shared source ingestion baseline. materializationMs is retained only as the original serial proof baseline used to reconstruct conservative setup time; current continuous four-writer processing and all known costs are in runtimeBudget.
clockScope: Controlled future scheduler clocks replay held real publisher bytes and retain actual source dates. Tomorrow is not due; nextWeekly confirms the same archive edition. No future HTTP observation is claimed. The separate complete real-gap retention scan measures the changed-edition branch without inventing changed future source bytes.
feedsFrom: Actual production registration identities and the official EPA exporter -> native archive/CSV reader -> normalizeEcho -> national OpenDataSpool -> shared four-writer artifact materializer.
feeds: Registered publishOpenData -> complete canonical national manifest -> normal selected PostgreSQL reader -> actual Netlify SDK artifact transport -> GET /api/open-data -> OpenDataFacts page renderer and grounded Ask evidence adapter.

runtimeBudget.scope: Conservative changed-edition processing: the actual archive HTTP download, measured held-byte source ingestion and unchanged indexing, complete continuous four-writer materialization, actual production registration reads, actual national publisher and actual retention over all primary records for the17 real gaps. No extrapolated rows or latency deductions; all proof-codec overhead remains included. Future source HTTP and production remote-vault latency are unmeasured.

artifactIntegrity.scope: Exhaustive offline artifact and primary-ID verification. Its wall time includes quiet reader/profile holds; no verification time enters the measured production processing sum.
artifactIntegrity.encoding: Proof-local gzip level1; every get returns and checks exact production bytes and metadata.

readerSummary.jit: off, matching production reader startup options
readerSummary.scope: Actual normal GET per page; API/card timings exclude no local transport work. Grounded Ask evidence adapter is checked; a full grounded model request is not timed.

cacheInvalidationScope: The read-only local Netlify proxy accepts only SDK artifact routes and rejects /api/v1/purge locally before any external request. Publication logs that replay-only warning and direct normal reads continue. Deployed edge-cache purge is not measured or claimed.
limitations: Future official-source response time and deployed Netlify remote artifact latency/QPS are unmeasured; the live scheduled check is still required after shipping.
The measured materializer RSS is a phase peak, not a whole-job peak or an observed production admission limit. See memoryCapacity in epa-four-writer-performance.json.

The three-clock source replay uses the same captured official edition. Exact retention correctness has a changed-input regression, and the real 17-gap complete prior-manifest scan is separately measured.
